name: @mu-agent/mu
description: Mu, a general-purpose extensible AI agent platform for the terminal and TypeScript

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --target=bun --minify --outfile dist/mu.js && bun build src/sdk.ts --target=bun --minify --external zod --outfile dist/index.js && bun ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b ./tsconfig.json --force && bun ../../scripts/prepare-sdk-declarations.ts
scripts.verify:sdk: bun run build && bun ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --strict --allowImportingTsExtensions --target ESNext --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --types bun testing/sdk-consumer.ts && bun testing/sdk-consumer.ts

author: Spandan Chavan
